desc: Ruger 77/357 rotary magazine bolt-action rifles include the following features: Patented detachable rotary magazine mounts flush with the stock to eliminate protrusions at the rifle's balance point. The powerful Ruger 77/357 is chambered in .357 Mag. 4-round capacity. Solid, heat-treated alloy steel action that features a one-piece right-hand turning bolt with 90-degree bolt lift and ultra-fast lock time for added accuracy. Patented integral scope rings. (included free). Easily accessible three-position safety that allows the shooter to lock the bolt, or to load and unload, with the safety engaged. Integral sling swivels.
